units: <cite ref="Pesachim 15b:6">Pes. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ חולין</he> an unnecessary destruction of &c.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 15b:6">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ מרובה</he> a considerable loss, opp. <he>ה׳ מועט</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:1">Ab. II, 1</cite> <he>ה׳ מצוה</he> the loss (inconvenience, sacrifice) connected with the performance of a good deed.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:11">Ib. V, 11</cite>, sq. <he>וצא שכרו בהֶפְסֵדוֹ</he> his advantage is set off by his disadvantage.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:11">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>הֶפְסֵדָהּ</he> the disadvantage of (punishment for) neglecting it, opp. <he>שכרה</he> reward for observing it.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 115b:15">B. Kam. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני ה׳ כהן</he> because it is an injury to the priest (entitled to it).
<cite ref="Shabbat 147b:15">Sabb. 147ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ אוכלין</he> a waste of eatables; a. fr.
